title: Terms of Service

When you log workout results or submit feedback, you grant us a non-exclusive license to display that content on the site. You retain ownership of any content you create.

You agree not to submit content that is false, harmful, or in violation of any third-party rights.

Fitness Disclaimer

All workouts and fitness content on HomeWODRx are for informational purposes only. Consult a qualified healthcare provider before beginning any exercise program.

HomeWODRx is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always warm up properly, use appropriate weights, and exercise within your ability level.

Affiliate Links

Some links on the Gear Shop and blog posts are affiliate links. If you purchase through one of these links, we may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. We only recommend products we believe are genuinely useful for functional fitness athletes.

Termination

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms. You may delete your account at any time from your Profile settings.

Changes to These Terms

We may update these Terms from time to time. We will note the updated date at the top of this page. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
